worldattribute-terrariumEnabled-desc: Replace the terrain with a replica of the real Earth built from real-world elevation data. Requires an internet connection while exploring new areas.
worldattribute-terrariumOriginLatitude-d: Real-world latitude (-90 to 90) placed at the world center, where players spawn.
worldattribute-terrariumOriginLongitude-: Real-world longitude (-180 to 180) placed at the world center, where players spawn.
worldattribute-terrariumHorizontalScale-: Real-world meters per block. At 40 m/block the whole Earth fits a 1 million block wide world.
worldattribute-terrariumVerticalScale-de: Auto exaggerates lowlands and compresses high mountains so the whole Earth fits the world height. The m/block values are linear; terrain above the world height is cut off.
worldattribute-terrariumRealWeather-desc: Use the current real weather of each area (from Open-Meteo.com). Can be changed later with /realweather. Rain and temperature also need the mod on the client.
worldattribute-terrariumRealWeatherPreci: Rain, snow, hail and thunderstorms follow the real weather.
worldattribute-terrariumRealWeatherCloud: Cloud cover and fog follow the real weather.
worldattribute-terrariumRealWeatherWind-: Wind strength follows the real wind speed.
worldattribute-terrariumRealWeatherTempe: Shifts the temperature by how much warmer or colder than normal it really is today. A real cold spell can damage crops.
